## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests and checks pass locally (`npm run ci` runs them all)
- [ ] I have reviewed my own code and understand all of it — including any parts written with AI assistance
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed
- [ ] New assets have verified redistribution rights and are listed in `docs/governance/third-party-assets.md`
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or private profiling data are included
- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
